description: List every check at a PR's current head — workflow runs, gates and commit statuses — with status, conclusion, whether branch protection requires it, and the run's log URL; plus each required check's state (passing / pending / failing / missing) and the merge gate's own CI verdict. A failed workflow run carries `failure`: the failed job and step, up to 8 file:line rows linked to the head sha, the tool's own guidance block ("What now?"), `budget` when a time budget rather than a test stopped the step (run conclusion `timed_out`: still blocks the merge), and the full step log URL — or `{withheld, required, hint}` when this credential may not read the run's logs (a private repository needs 'repo' scope). Read-only. Returns {head_sha, total_count, check_runs, required, ci}.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_get_pr_checks
